IF OBJECT_ID(N'TsMgmt.dbo.HolidayCalendarKR', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE TsMgmt.dbo.HolidayCalendarKR (
        HolidayDate DATE NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_HolidayCalendarKR PRIMARY KEY,
        HolidayName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        IsHoliday BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_HolidayCalendarKR_IsHoliday DEFAULT ((1)),
        SourceType NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
        SourceYear INT NOT NULL,
        CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_HolidayCalendarKR_CreatedAt DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME()),
        UpdatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_HolidayCalendarKR_UpdatedAt DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME())
    );

    CREATE INDEX IX_HolidayCalendarKR_SourceYear
        ON TsMgmt.dbo.HolidayCalendarKR (SourceYear, HolidayDate);
END;
